items.en: Ukraine says it hit Roboavia drone plant in Rostov Oblast; Ryazan refinery halts main unit after drone attack
items.nl: Oekraïne meldt treffer op dronefabriek Roboavia in oblast Rostov; raffinaderij Rjazan legt hoofdinstallatie stil na droneaanval
items.sEn: Ukraine's General Staff says Ukrainian forces struck the Roboavia plant near the settlement of Khutor Lenina in Russia's Rostov Oblast on Friday 16 October, hitting a production and storage building and damaging the company's infrastructure.
